description: Return static per-channel metadata: character limits, Markdown support flags, tag vocabulary, and CTA placement rules. Side effects: read-only; no external HTTP calls; no auth needed. Fully deterministic — returns compile-time adapter constants. Use channel_hints before composing a variant body to understand channel constraints; use post_publish or post_schedule once you have a valid variant.

channel.description: Channel platform name, e.g. 'devto', 'reddit', 'hashnode', 'bluesky'. Use the platform prefix only, not the full 'platform:account' form.

name: channel_hints

browser_only.description: True when posting requires the browser-fallback flow (no public API).

canonical_url_supported.description: Whether the channel honours canonical_url natively.

cta_placement.description: Where the CTA block lands on this channel.

max_length.description: Max post length in characters; omitted when the channel has no limit.

supported_md_features.description: Markdown features the channel renders, e.g. 'links', 'code_blocks'.

tag_vocab.description: Canonical tag vocabulary; omitted when the channel accepts free-form tags.

title: Static per-channel metadata
